author: Kristy Puchko
quote: A compelling and oddball coming-of-age comedy, Run Amok is a gem.

author: Elizabeth Weitzman
quote: Newcomer Alyssa Marvin guides this beguiling, darkly comic high school feature with charm and precision

author: Pete Hammond
quote: Give credit to debuting feature filmmaker NB Mager for a bold idea and a teen-driven movie that could spark the right kind of conversation.

author: Kate Erbland
quote: The film marks the feature film debut of both young stars, and they offer enough gravitas and grace to carry it.

author: Peter Gray
quote: Mager delivers a debut that feels both singular and essential – a film that dares to ask not how we move on, but whether we ever truly can.

author: Dan Tabor
quote: Run Amok is an ambitious and audacious little film that delivers laughs while refusing to shy away from the harder questions beneath them.

author: Peyton Robinson
quote: It delivers its thesis with the gall of an ambitious filmmaker unafraid of their voice and instincts.

author: Peter Gray
quote: Run Amok is a tender, unconventional, and deeply humane piece of art that honors the voices of those most often sidelined in conversations about tragedy.

author: Dan Tabor
quote: Much of that success rests on Alyssa Marvin, who carries the film with striking confidence and vulnerability.

author: Peyton Robinson
quote: What buoys “Run Amok” more than anything is Marvin’s incredibly affecting performance.
